name: ADMIN — KeyCRM Pipeline Card Index Incremental Sync

parameters.name: filter[updated_between]
parameters.value: ={{ new Date($('Load sync window').first().json.from_ts).toISOString() + ',' + new Date($('Load sync window').first().json.to_ts).toISOString() }}

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS cards, $2::timestamptz AS checkpoint
),
source_rows AS (
  SELECT
    (card->>'card_id')::bigint AS card_id,
    (card->>'pipeline_id')::bigint AS pipeline_id,
    NULLIF(card->>'source_id','')::bigint AS source_id,
    NULLIF(card->>'manager_id','')::bigint AS manager_id,
    NULLIF(card->>'status_id','')::bigint AS status_id,
    NULLIF(card->>'status_alias','') AS status_alias,
    NULLIF(card->>'status_title','') AS status_title,
    NULLIF(card->>'status_is_final','')::boolean AS status_is_final,
    NULLIF(card->>'is_finished','')::boolean AS is_finished,
    NULLIF(card->>'closed_from','')::bigint AS closed_from,
    NULLIF(card->>'created_at','')::timestamptz AS created_at,
    NULLIF(card->>'updated_at','')::timestamptz AS updated_at,
    NULLIF(card->>'status_changed_at','')::timestamptz AS status_changed_at,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(card->>'payments_total','')::numeric,0) AS payments_total,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(card->>'products_total','')::numeric,0) AS products_total,
    NULLIF(card->>'utm_source','') AS utm_source,
    NULLIF(card->>'utm_medium','') AS utm_medium,
    NULLIF(card->>'utm_campaign','') AS utm_campaign,
    input.checkpoint AS synced_at
  FROM input CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(input.cards) AS card
),
assignment_events AS (
  INSERT INTO public.keycrm_pipeline_assignment_events(
    card_id,changed_at,old_manager_id,new_manager_id,old_source_id,new_source_id,observed_at
  )
  SELECT
    s.card_id,
    COALESCE(s.updated_at, input.checkpoint),
    old.manager_id,
    s.manager_id,
    old.source_id,
    s.source_id,
    now()
  FROM source_rows s
  JOIN public.keycrm_pipeline_cards old ON old.card_id=s.card_id
  CROSS JOIN input
  WHERE (old.manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.manager_id OR old.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.source_id)
    AND COALESCE(s.updated_at,input.checkpoint) >= COALESCE((SELECT tracking_started_at FROM public.keycrm_pipeline_tracking_meta WHERE id=1), input.checkpoint)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.keycrm_pipeline_cards(
    card_id,pipeline_id,source_id,manager_id,status_id,status_alias,status_title,status_is_final,is_finished,closed_from,
    created_at,updated_at,status_changed_at,payments_total,products_total,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,synced_at
  )
  SELECT card_id,pipeline_id,source_id,manager_id,status_id,status_alias,status_title,status_is_final,is_finished,closed_from,
    created_at,updated_at,status_changed_at,payments_total,products_total,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,synced_at
  FROM source_rows
  ON CONFLICT(card_id) DO UPDATE SET
    pipeline_id=EXCLUDED.pipeline_id,source_id=EXCLUDED.source_id,manager_id=EXCLUDED.manager_id,status_id=EXCLUDED.status_id,
    status_alias=EXCLUDED.status_alias,status_title=EXCLUDED.status_title,status_is_final=EXCLUDED.status_is_final,is_finished=EXCLUDED.is_finished,
    closed_from=EXCLUDED.closed_from,created_at=EXCLUDED.created_at,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at,status_changed_at=EXCLUDED.status_changed_at,
    payments_total=EXCLUDED.payments_total,products_total=EXCLUDED.products_total,utm_source=EXCLUDED.utm_source,utm_medium=EXCLUDED.utm_medium,
    utm_campaign=EXCLUDED.utm_campaign,synced_at=EXCLUDED.synced_at
  RETURNING card_id
),
state_update AS (
  INSERT INTO public.keycrm_sync_state(sync_name,last_successful_sync_at,last_count,updated_at)
  SELECT 'pipeline_cards_incremental', input.checkpoint, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upserted), now() FROM input
  ON CONFLICT(sync_name) DO UPDATE SET last_successful_sync_at=EXCLUDED.last_successful_sync_at,last_count=EXCLUDED.last_count,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
  RETURNING last_successful_sync_at,last_count,updated_at
)
SELECT last_successful_sync_at,last_count,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM assignment_events) AS assignment_events_created,updated_at FROM state_update;
